original-johto.flavorText: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some trainers use them in place of clocks.

hoenn.flavorText: It has an internal organ that senses the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It switches its standing foot so quickly, it can’t be seen. It cries at the same time every day.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.

updated-johto.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

original-unova.flavorText: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.

updated-unova.flavorText: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.

kalos.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Hoothoot has an internal organ that senses and tracks the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, this Pokémon begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.

updated-alola.flavorText: It cries out at the same time every day. A long time ago, people cherished it and considered it a divine messenger sent to tell the time.
